datasets.description: Malawi Medium Term Projection FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2020. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/malawi_medium_term_projection__fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2020]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule throughout 2020, classifying geographic areas in Malawi by food insecurity phase. The data represents medium-term projections of acute food insecurity conditions, with classifications stored as spatial features (GeoJSON/KML) linked to IPC phase values and collection metadata.
